desc: Detect cycle vertices by repeatedly removing indegree-zero vertices, and group each remaining directed cycle as one equal-valued component root.
Compute bottom-up DP for every non-cycle vertex, where its value-\(v\) count is the product of prefix sums of its children’s DPs through \(v\).
For each cycle, multiply prefix-sum contributions from all non-cycle children attached to its vertices, sum over its shared root value, and multiply independent component answers.
Produce a stdin/stdout Python implementation in \(O(NM)\) time and validate it against the stated samples.
